reason: I'm not putting a bot into the group where my staff talk about guests, owners and payments, and I'm not hooking it up to my Google account either. My admin already puts the transfer screenshots into a sheet, so $19 a month just pays for something I already have.
objection: A bot in my work chat and connected to my Google means some unknown company can see my villas' money and guest messages. 'Sees only one sheet' is just their word, and I can't check it.
would_change_my_mind: If my admin ran the free 30 by forwarding receipts to the bot privately, never adding it to the group, and it caught a real duplicate or wrong transfer that we had missed.
